# `data/` — how these files relate to each other

This folder is gitignored (student-identifying data, never committed — see the top-level
README). Most files here are **not useful on their own**: they're intermediate checkpoints
built from one another by the notebooks in `notebooks/industry_growth_analysis/`, not
independent exports. This doc exists so that fact doesn't have to be re-discovered every time.

## Two separate families of files

**1. Raw exports** — pulled from InPlace/Airtable/BLS, never regenerated by a notebook.
Irreplaceable if lost; re-export from the source system if missing.

**2. Derived/checkpoint files** — written by a notebook, read by a later one. Safe to delete
and regenerate by re-running the notebook that produces them (some cost real time/API calls
to rebuild — see notes below).

## The industry-growth chain (the big one)

```
AllRoles_clean.csv                          <- RAW, root of everything below.
  |                                            Not produced by any notebook in this repo —
  |                                            currently MISSING from this checkout. IMPORTANT:  
  |                                            can be found on InPlace Query: made by JA,
  |                                            titled: "Airtable - CCL'26 Internship Opportunities" 
  |                                            Every notebook below depends on it, directly or
  |                                            through a derived file. Re-locate/re-export
  |                                            this before running the pipeline fresh.
  |
  |-- notebooks/industry_growth_analysis/role_classification/RolesWithDescALL.ipynb
  |     filters to the 4 core hubs, requires non-blank title+description
  v
AllRoles_nioccs_ready.csv                   <- one row per historical opportunity, ready
  |                                            to send to the NIOCCS API
  |
  |-- same notebook, NIOCCS API coding (NAICS/SOC), + a 2023-specific rerun
  v
AllRoles_nioccs_coded.csv                   <- + NAICS/SOC codes, match probabilities,
  |                                            insufficient-info / implausible-pairing flags
  |
  |-- notebooks/industry_growth_analysis/tag_education_requirements.ipynb
  |     joins BLS Employment Projections Table 5.4 (education.xlsx) by SOC code
  v
AllRoles_nioccs_coded_with_education.csv    <- + typical entry-level education required.
                                                This is the file most downstream analysis
                                                actually reads.
```

### Cultural Corps — a parallel chain that merges back in

Cultural Corps was originally out of scope (different hub-labeling), then brought in later
via `notebooks/industry_growth_analysis/cultural_corp_ingestion/`:

```
AllRoles_clean.csv
  |-- culturalcorps.ipynb (Steps 1-3): filter to Opportunity Type Name == "Cultural Corps"
  v
cultural_corps/cc_step2_ready_for_nioccs.csv
  |-- NIOCCS API coding (same logic, longer MAX_DESCRIPTION_CHARS — these descriptions run
  |   longer than the core-hub postings)
  v
cultural_corps/cc_step3_coded.csv
  |-- culturalcorpsmerge.ipynb (Step 4): merges cc_step2_*/cc_step3_* INTO
  |   AllRoles_nioccs_ready.csv / AllRoles_nioccs_coded.csv in place (backs up originals
  |   first). tag_education_requirements.ipynb must be re-run after this so the merged-in
  |   Cultural Corps rows get education tags too.
  v
(folded into AllRoles_nioccs_ready.csv / AllRoles_nioccs_coded.csv above)
```

### Max Placements — a capacity correction joined on afterward

`AllRoles_clean.csv` also carries a `Max Places` column (how many students a posting can
actually hold — most analysis before this correction counted 1 opportunity = 1 placement,
which undercounts high-capacity postings). `notebooks/industry_growth_analysis/placement_join/
placements_analysis.ipynb`'s first step joins this back onto both coded files in place
(backing up originals first) as a `Max Placements` column, so downstream charts can sum actual
capacity instead of counting rows.

### The external comparison side

```
BLS QCEW API (external)
  |-- notebooks/industry_growth_analysis/public_data_fetch/public.ipynb (cells 0-1)
  v
qcew_nyc_sector_citywide.csv                <- citywide NYC employment by NAICS sector,
                                                2022-2025 annual averages. The denominator
                                                side of every "us vs. citywide" comparison.
```

`AllRoles_nioccs_ready.csv` + `AllRoles_nioccs_coded_with_education.csv` +
`qcew_nyc_sector_citywide.csv` feed `placement_join/placements_analysis.ipynb`'s Ground Truth
Analysis (the current, canonical version of the internal-vs-citywide comparison) and
`placement_join/healthcare_sector_check.ipynb`'s hub-composition sanity check — the gate that
catches a QCEW sector name (e.g. "Health Care and Social Assistance") getting misattributed to
the wrong internal hub before it's named in a deck Finding.

`public_data_fetch/public.ipynb`'s later cells (2-5) also write several `*.csv`/`*.png`
comparison/growth files directly into `data/` — these are earlier, superseded drafts of the
same comparison now done in `placements_analysis.ipynb`; not deleted, but not the ones to trust.

### Final stakeholder deliverable

`notebooks/industry_growth_analysis/to_excel/to_excel.ipynb` combines
`AllRoles_nioccs_ready.csv` + `AllRoles_nioccs_coded_with_education.csv` +
`cultural_corps/cc_step2_ready_for_nioccs.csv` + `cultural_corps/cc_step3_coded.csv` into
`outputs/industry_growth_analysis/Sector_Detail_Workbook.xlsx` — the sheet stakeholders
actually get.

## What's safe to delete and regenerate

- `*_BACKUP_before_*.csv` — safety copies written automatically before any script mutates
  `AllRoles_nioccs_ready.csv` / `AllRoles_nioccs_coded*.csv` in place. Safe to delete once
  you've confirmed the mutation it's guarding against was correct; nothing reads them back.
- `*_rerun.csv` / other one-off checkpoint files (e.g. `AllRoles_nioccs_coded_2023_rerun.csv`)
  — intermediate state from a specific fix, already merged into the main coded file. Safe to
  delete after confirming the merge.
- Anything under the `AllRoles_nioccs_*` chain — regenerable by re-running
  `role_classification/RolesWithDescALL.ipynb` end to end, but this re-hits the NIOCCS API for
  every row (rate-limited, not instant) — don't delete casually.

## What's irreplaceable

- `AllRoles_clean.csv` — see above, currently missing, nothing here rebuilds it.
- Raw exports used by the `matching/` project (`CareerLaunch2026PlacementHistory.csv`,
  `CL26StudentOpportunityApplications*.csv`, the rematch-request CSV, `PlacementHistory.xlsx`,
  `SF26StudentOpportunityApplications.xlsx`, `Opportunityapplicationhistorytest.csv`) — these
  are direct InPlace/Airtable exports, not derived from anything else in this repo. Some of
  these are also currently missing from this checkout; re-export from InPlace/Airtable if
  needed.
